name: Change Log
one_liner: Every requested change to the baseline: its size, its priority, the approval decision and the actual delivery.
purpose: The Change Log is the register of project changes used for recording, assessing, monitoring, controlling and tracking change requests and their respective decisions. It brings transparency, accountability and traceability to every change made after the project scope and plans have been baselined, and serves as the means of communicating changes to the Project Owner (PO) and/or Project Steering Committee (PSC) for approval. Approved or merged changes are carried into the Project Work Plan and the related plans and logs are updated.
created_in: Planning Phase (set up with the Project Change Management Plan, p.31)
approved_by: n/a as a log - each change is approved or rejected by the Project Owner (PO) and/or the Project Steering Committee (PSC) (p.76)
inputs: Issue Log and other Project Logs

traps: Appendix B p.96 prints 'Assessing'; glossary p.124 prints 'Investigating' - same status.
The template's six statuses omit 'Waiting for approval' and 'Merged'; it says not exhaustive.
A change is not an issue: a verbal scope request needs a Change Request Form and log entry.
Size and Priority are separate 1-5 scores; there is no L x I product here.
Project Change Management Plan defines the process; the Change Log records the changes.
